картина: Обзорная страница раздела Models → Safety документации Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform для разработчиков приложений/агентов на Gemini. Перечисляет риски (контент, бренд, выравнивание, безопасность/приватность) и таблицу инструментов: Default settings, Configurable Filters (пороги BLOCK_*), System Instructions, Model Armor, DLP, Gemini as a Filter, Multi-layered approach, C2PA Content Credentials; завершает абзацем о непрерывной оценке безопасности. Генерации изображений касаются только C2PA (Gemini 3 Pro Image во вступлении, 'supported models' в таблице) и мультимодальность Gemini-фильтра. Повторные акценты: связка filters + system instructions (дважды), 'модель может не следовать инструкциям' (дважды), cost/latency каждого слоя. Термины: 'non-configurable filters', 'Recitation', 'Gemini as a filter', 'Multi-layered approach'.

единицы.утверждение_en: Generative AI models like Gemini require robust safety measures to mitigate risks such as generating harmful content, leaking sensitive information, or being misused; Google Cloud's Agent Platform provides a suite of tools and practices for holistic safety.
единицы.цитата:
Generative AI models like Gemini require robust safety measures to
mitigate risks such as generating harmful content, leaking sensitive
information, or being misused.
единицы.раздел: Safety in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform

единицы.утверждение_en: When deploying Gemini models, identify and mitigate potential risks proactively; a multi-layered approach to safety is described as critical.
единицы.цитата:
When deploying Gemini models, it's crucial to identify and mitigate
various potential risks. A proactive approach to understanding these risks
allows for more effective implementation of safety measures. A multi-layered
approach to safety is critical
единицы.раздел: Potential safety risks and mitigation strategies
единицы.заметка: 'crucial'/'critical' — совет по построению защиты, не условие API.

единицы.утверждение_en: Content risks include harmful content, profanity and sexualization, and violence and gore.
единицы.цитата:
Content risks: These can include content that's harmful, profanity and
sexualization, and violence and gore.
единицы.раздел: Potential safety risks and mitigation strategies

единицы.утверждение_en: Brand safety risks: generated content may not align with your brand's tone or values, may endorse competitors or inappropriate products, or may cause reputational damage.
единицы.цитата:
Brand safety risks: Generated content may not align with your brand's
tone or values, it may endorse competitors or inappropriate products, or
generate content that can result in reputational damage.
единицы.раздел: Potential safety risks and mitigation strategies

единицы.утверждение_en: Alignment risks: generated content may be irrelevant or inaccurate.
единицы.цитата: Alignment risks: Generated content may be irrelevant or inaccurate.
единицы.раздел: Potential safety risks and mitigation strategies

единицы.утверждение_en: Security and privacy risks: generated content may leak sensitive training data or prompts, and adversarial users may try to force the model to override safety protocols.
единицы.цитата:
Security and privacy risks: Generated content may leak sensitive
training data or prompts, or adversarial users may attempt to force the
model to override safety protocols or behave in unintended ways.
единицы.раздел: Potential safety risks and mitigation strategies

единицы.утверждение_en: The default model and non-configurable filters provide a general safety net.
единицы.цитата: The default model and non-configurable filters provide a general safety net.
единицы.раздел: Potential safety risks and mitigation strategies

единицы.утверждение_en: System instructions provide direct guidance to the model on preferred behavior and topics to avoid.
единицы.цитата:
System instructions
provide direct guidance to the model on preferred behavior and topics to
avoid.
единицы.раздел: Potential safety risks and mitigation strategies

единицы.утверждение_en: Content filters let you set specific thresholds for common harm types.
единицы.цитата:
Content filters allow
you to set specific thresholds for common harm types.
единицы.раздел: Potential safety risks and mitigation strategies

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini as a filter offers an advanced, customizable checkpoint for complex or nuanced safety concerns that earlier layers might miss or that need context-aware evaluation.
единицы.цитата:
Gemini as a filter
offers an advanced, customizable checkpoint for complex or nuanced safety
concerns that might be missed by the preceding layers or require more
context-aware evaluation.
единицы.раздел: Potential safety risks and mitigation strategies

единицы.утверждение_en: Model Armor provides enterprise-grade protection against prompt injection and jailbreaks, content harms, sensitive data protection, malware detection and safe browsing.
единицы.цитата: Model Armor provides enterprise-grade protection against prompt injection and jailbreaks, content harms, sensitive data protection, and malware detection and safe browsing.
единицы.раздел: Potential safety risks and mitigation strategies

единицы.утверждение_en: DLP addresses the risk of sensitive data leakage when the model has access to sensitive data, and enables custom block lists.
единицы.цитата:
DLP
specifically addresses the critical risk of sensitive data leakage, in case the
model has access to sensitive data. It also enables the ability to create custom
block lists.
единицы.раздел: Potential safety risks and mitigation strategies

единицы.утверждение_en: Content Credentials add cryptographically signed C2PA metadata to images generated with the Gemini 3 Pro Image model, indicating they are AI-generated and giving a verifiable history of their origin.
единицы.цитата:
Content Credentials add
cryptographically signed C2PA metadata to images generated
using the Gemini 3 Pro Image model, indicating that
they are AI-generated and providing a verifiable history of their origin.
единицы.раздел: Potential safety risks and mitigation strategies
единицы.заметка: Единственное место страницы с конкретной image-моделью. В таблице (E-99-35) — 'For supported models' без перечня.

единицы.утверждение_en: Default settings include an independent protection layer designed to prevent generating content related to Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) or copyrighted content (Recitation); Gemini models are also designed with safety in mind even against adversarial prompts.
единицы.цитата:
The default settings include an
independent protection layer designed to prevent the generation of content related
to Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) or Copyrighted Content (Recitation).
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — Default settings: Gemini + non-configurable filters
единицы.заметка: Ячейка 'How it works'; декларативные фразы до неё учтены в утверждении.

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini's default safety might not meet your organization's needs: the model can hallucinate or not follow instructions, and motivated attackers may still succeed in jailbreaks and prompt injection.
единицы.цитата:
Gemini's default safety might not meet your organization's needs. The model can
hallucinate or not follow instructions. Motivated attackers may still succeed in
jailbreaks and prompt injection
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — Default settings: Gemini + non-configurable filters

единицы.утверждение_en: Relying on default settings alone is suited to workflows where no malicious input is expected.
единицы.цитата: Workflows where no malicious input is expected
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — Default settings: Gemini + non-configurable filters

единицы.утверждение_en: Configurable filters cover harm categories such as sexual, hate, harassment and dangerous content; a blocking threshold (e.g. BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE, BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE, BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH) can be set per category based on probability and/or severity.
единицы.цитата:
You can configure blocking thresholds for each harm category
(e.g., BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE, BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE,
BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH) based on the probability and/or severity of the harmful
content.
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — Configurable Filters

единицы.утверждение_en: Configurable filters are an independent layer from the model, so they are robust against jailbreaks.
единицы.цитата:
These are an independent layer from the model so are robust against
jailbreaks.
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — Configurable Filters

единицы.утверждение_en: Configurable filters lack fine-grained customization beyond thresholds for predefined categories and may occasionally block benign content (false positives) or miss harmful content (false negatives).
единицы.цитата:
Lacks fine-grained customization beyond threshold settings for predefined categories.
May occasionally block benign content (false positives) or miss some harmful
content (false negatives).
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — Configurable Filters

единицы.утверждение_en: Configurable content filters are only available for response filtering, not prompt filtering.
единицы.цитата:
Only available for response filtering, not prompt
filtering.
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — Configurable Filters

единицы.утверждение_en: Configurable filters give a base level of safety for user-facing applications or agents; to ensure content and brand safety, pair content filters with system instructions.
единицы.цитата:
If your goal
is to ensure content and brand safety, content filters should be paired with
system instructions.
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — Configurable Filters

единицы.утверждение_en: You can instruct the model on your brand and content safety guidelines through system instructions or preambles, e.g. tell it "don't answer questions related to politics" or to adhere to specific brand voice and tone guidelines.
единицы.цитата:
You can instruct the model on your brand and content safety guidelines through
system instructions or preambles. For example, you can tell the model "don't
answer questions related to politics" or to adhere to specific brand voice and
tone guidelines.
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — System Instructions
единицы.заметка: Пример системной инструкции текстовый; для image-моделей не конкретизирован.

единицы.утверждение_en: System instructions do not guarantee compliance: the model can hallucinate or not follow instructions, and motivated attackers may still succeed in jailbreaks and prompt injection.
единицы.цитата:
The model can hallucinate or not follow instructions. Motivated attackers may still
succeed in jailbreaks and prompt injection
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — System Instructions
единицы.заметка: Тот же риск, что у Default settings (E-99-15), применён к системным инструкциям.

единицы.утверждение_en: System instructions suit applications or agents requiring adherence to specific brand guidelines or nuanced content policies; to ensure content and brand safety, pair system instructions with content filters.
единицы.цитата:
Applications or agents requiring adherence to specific brand guidelines or nuanced
content policies. If your goal is to ensure content and brand safety, system
instructions should be paired with content filters.
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — System Instructions

единицы.утверждение_en: Model Armor is a Google Cloud service that proactively screens LLM prompts and responses; it can be used whether AI is deployed on Google Cloud or other cloud providers.
единицы.цитата:
It works by proactively screening
LLM prompts and responses, protecting against various risks and ensuring
responsible AI practices. Whether you are deploying AI in Google Cloud or other
cloud providers, Model Armor can help you prevent malicious
input
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — Model Armor

единицы.утверждение_en: Model Armor adds cost and latency and is a paid offering for customers with enterprise needs.
единицы.цитата: Cost and latency.Paid offering for customers with enterprise needs.
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — Model Armor

единицы.утверждение_en: The DLP API inspects text to identify and classify sensitive information via predefined and custom infoType detectors, can apply redaction, masking or tokenization, and can be used to block keywords.
единицы.цитата:
The DLP API can inspect text to identify and classify sensitive
information based on a wide range of predefined and custom infoType detectors.
Once identified, it can apply de-identification techniques such as redaction,
masking, or tokenization. The DLP API can also be used to block
keywords.
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — DLP for custom block lists and Sensitive data protection

единицы.утверждение_en: Input protection: before sending user prompts or data to Gemini, pass the text through the DLP API to redact or mask sensitive information, so it is not processed or logged by the model.
единицы.цитата:
Input Protection: Before sending user prompts or data to
Gemini, you can pass the text through the DLP API to
redact or mask any sensitive information. This prevents sensitive data from being
processed or logged by the model.
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — DLP for custom block lists and Sensitive data protection
единицы.заметка: В этой версии страницы Input/Output Protection слиты с описанием в один абзац.

единицы.утверждение_en: Output protection: if Gemini might inadvertently generate or reveal sensitive information, its output can be scanned by the DLP API before being sent to the user.
единицы.цитата:
Output Protection: If there's a risk that
Gemini might inadvertently generate or reveal sensitive information
(e.g., if it's summarizing source documents containing PII), the model's output
can be scanned by the DLP API before being sent to the user.
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — DLP for custom block lists and Sensitive data protection

единицы.утверждение_en: DLP adds latency and can lead to over-blocking; it is meant as data loss protection for agents that have access to sensitive data.
единицы.цитата: Adds latency. Can lead to over-blocking.Data loss protection for agents that have access to sensitive data.
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — DLP for custom block lists and Sensitive data protection

единицы.утверждение_en: Gemini as a filter: make a second call to a fast, cost-effective Gemini model (such as Gemini Flash or Flash Lite) to evaluate whether user/tool input or the primary model's output is safe, with instructions to decide safe/unsafe based on your policies (content safety, brand safety, agent misalignment).
единицы.цитата:
This involves making a second call to a fast and cost-effective Gemini model
(such as Gemini Flash or Flash Lite) to evaluate whether the input from
a user or tool, or the output from your primary Gemini model, is safe. The
filter model is given instructions to decide if the content is safe or unsafe
based on your defined policies including content safety, brand safety, and agent
misalignment.
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — Gemini as a Filter
единицы.заметка: Модели-фильтры: 'Gemini Flash or Flash Lite' (не image).

единицы.утверждение_en: A Gemini filter model can analyze text, images, video, and audio, offering protection against content safety violations, brand safety issues, model drift, and hallucinations.
единицы.цитата:
This offers robust and highly customizable protection against
content safety violations, brand safety issues, model drift, and hallucinations
and can analyze text, images, video, and audio for a holistic understanding.
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — Gemini as a Filter
единицы.заметка: Единственный слой, прямо названный способным анализировать изображения.

единицы.утверждение_en: Using Gemini as a filter adds cost and latency, with a chance of extremely rare false negatives.
единицы.цитата: Additional cost and latency. Chance of extremely rare false negatives.
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — Gemini as a Filter

единицы.утверждение_en: A multi-layered approach (configurable filters + system instructions + DLP + Gemini as a filter) adds cost and latency and is for a robust level of safety in user-facing applications or agents, especially where adversarial and malicious use is expected.
единицы.цитата:
Additional cost and latency.
Provide a robust level of safety for user-facing applications or agents,
especially where adversarial and malicious use is expected
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — Multi-layered approach
единицы.заметка: Ячейка 'How it works' этой строки таблицы в html пустая (); состав слоёв — из названия строки; Model Armor в состав не входит.

единицы.утверждение_en: For supported models, Agent Platform automatically adds cryptographically signed Content Credentials to generated images per the C2PA standard, indicating they are AI-generated and giving a verifiable history of their origin.
единицы.цитата:
For supported models, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform automatically adds cryptographically
signed Content Credentials to generated images, indicating they are AI-generated and
providing a verifiable history of their origin according to the
C2PA standard.
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — C2PA Content Credentials
единицы.модели: не указано (в разделе — 'supported models'; во вступлении, E-99-13, названа Gemini 3 Pro Image)
единицы.заметка: 'automatically' — отдельного включения не требуется; перечня моделей нет.

единицы.утверждение_en: Use of non-compliant tools can compromise file authenticity, and Content Credentials do not guarantee the trustworthiness of the media source.
единицы.цитата:
Use of non-compliant tools can compromise file authenticity;
does not guarantee trustworthiness of media source.
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — C2PA Content Credentials

единицы.утверждение_en: C2PA Content Credentials are intended for media generation use cases where transparency about the origin and history of the file is important for user trust.
единицы.цитата:
Media generation use cases, where transparency about the origin and history
of the file is important for user trust.
единицы.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini — C2PA Content Credentials

единицы.утверждение_en: Continuous safety evaluation is crucial because the AI landscape and misuse methods are constantly evolving; regular evaluations help identify vulnerabilities, assess mitigation effectiveness, adapt to evolving risks, ensure alignment with policies and values, build trust, and maintain compliance.
единицы.цитата:
Continuous safety evaluation is crucial for AI systems, as the AI landscape and
misuse methods are constantly evolving.
единицы.раздел: Continuous safety evaluation

единицы.утверждение_en: Evaluation types include development evaluations, assurance evaluations, red teaming, external evaluations, and benchmark testing.
единицы.цитата:
Various evaluation types, including development evaluations, assurance
evaluations, red teaming, external evaluations, and benchmark testing, help
achieve this.
единицы.раздел: Continuous safety evaluation

единицы.утверждение_en: The scope of evaluation should cover content safety, brand safety, relevance, bias and fairness, truthfulness, and robustness to adversarial attacks.
единицы.цитата:
The scope of evaluation should cover content safety, brand safety,
relevance, bias and fairness, truthfulness, and robustness to adversarial
attacks.
единицы.раздел: Continuous safety evaluation

единицы.утверждение_en: Tools like the Gen AI evaluation service can assist; iterative improvements based on evaluation findings are essential.
единицы.цитата:
iterative improvements based on evaluation
findings are essential for responsible AI development.
единицы.раздел: Continuous safety evaluation

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Because configurable content filters act only on responses, prompt screening must come from other layers the page describes as inspecting inputs: DLP input protection, Model Armor (screens prompts), or Gemini as a filter (evaluates user/tool input).
длинная_дистанция.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Сопоставление ячеек таблицы; прямо не сформулировано.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Of the listed layers, only Gemini as a filter is described as able to analyze images (multimodal), via a second call to a fast model such as Flash or Flash Lite; DLP is described as inspecting text only — so checking generated images falls to the Gemini filter.
длинная_дистанция.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: The page states in both directions that content filters and system instructions should be paired when the goal is content and brand safety; neither is presented as sufficient alone.
длинная_дистанция.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Every layer beyond the defaults is presented with a cost: DLP adds latency and over-blocking, Model Armor cost/latency, Gemini as a filter cost/latency, multi-layered approach cost/latency.
длинная_дистанция.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Model-level controls (default Gemini behavior, system instructions) carry the stated risk that the model may not follow instructions and can be jailbroken, whereas configurable filters are called robust against jailbreaks because they are independent of the model.
длинная_дистанция.раздел: Available safety tools in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform for Gemini

противоречия_внутри: Разная широта охвата C2PA: вступление — 'images generated using the Gemini 3 Pro Image model' (E-99-13), таблица — 'For supported models' (E-99-35) без перечня.
Строка 'Multi-layered approach' таблицы не имеет описания (пустая ячейка 'How it works' в html) и не включает Model Armor, хотя во вступлении Model Armor назван среди слоёв.
